newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two inmates slain in Brazil jail uprising.
newsitem.headline: Two inmates slain in Brazil jail uprising.

text.p: Two inmates were killed and eight injured in the latest Brazilian jail riot in which prisoners have seized 15 hostages, including seven children, police said on Monday.

Police investigator Daniel Matos told Reuters a group of inmates rebelled during visiting hours and seized the relatives of other prisoners on Sunday afternoon at the Ferraz de Vasconcelos police lock-up outside Sao Paulo.
The slain inmates, who were responsible for cleaning the jail, were beaten and stabbed to death by other prisoners, Matos said.
Among the hostages are seven children aged four to eight, he said. Local TV Globo said one infant was released overnight but added a woman eight months pregnant was still among the captives.
"The prisoners are complaining about overcrowding and are demanding transfers," said Matos. He said the jail, built to hold 30 inmates, currently houses 175 prisoners.

Rebellions are common at Brazil's notoriously overcrowded jails and prisons but the country has been wracked recently by a rash of uprisings this year, including more than 50 in Sao Paulo state alone.
